title: 다음 비
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad with soft rock influences. Clean electric guitar plays arpeggiated chords with light chorus and delay. A fretless bass provides melodic counterpoint with sliding transitions. Drums feature a dry snare and soft kick, entering with a simple backbeat. Male vocals are delivered in a breathy, emotive tenor register with subtle vibrato. The arrangement builds with a lush string section providing sustained harmonic pads. Key of E Major. Tempo is 72 BPM. Time signature is 4/4.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean electric guitar arpeggio with chorus effect]

[Verse 1]
[breathy male vocals]
비가 쏟아져 [fretless bass enters with a slide]
회색빛 거리와
우산도 없이 걸어 [soft kick drum enters]
텅 빈 속엔 맞춰
그때 눈에 박혀 [snare hits on 2 and 4]
빨간 우산 하나
무채색 세상에서
너만 선명해서
